contradictions.claim_a: The existing MockRuntime fixture is already a mobile app because it has tauri.conf.json.
contradictions.claim_b: It is test-only: Cargo emits only rlib, src/lib.rs has only cfg(test), and no mobile_entry_point registers the plugin in a target host.

contradictions.claim_a: An empty capability attached beside an allowed capability removes permission.
contradictions.claim_b: Tauri merges permissions for matching capabilities; denial evidence needs a separate build/configuration that omits the allowed capability.

contradictions.claim_a: Attached devices mean the clean mobile lane is ready to run.
contradictions.claim_b: Targets and devices are ready, but the app host is absent, the repo has no pnpm Tauri CLI, cargo-tauri is one minor release behind, and unrelated VM descriptor pressure can still abort builds.
